hotels.title: Sri Lanka All-Inclusive Beachfront Bliss with Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks & One Child Stays Free
hotels.description: On Sri Lanka's southern coast, this contemporary beachfront resort sits minutes from Galle Fort, a UNESCO-listed citadel of Dutch-era ramparts, galleries and the Maritime Museum. Sea-facing rooms with butler service frame panoramic Indian Ocean vistas, while the landscaped grounds spill onto a wide sweep of sand. Galle Fort rewards an afternoon wander, so duck into a local cafe for cinnamon-laced coffee or browse Pedlar Street's independent boutiques. Beyond the fort, the region is Sri Lanka's spice heartland: cinnamon, pepper and cloves grow within minutes of the resort, and freshly caught seer fish and lagoon prawns are staples on every local table. Three distinct venues shape the culinary experience. At Catch Restaurant, guests pick their own seafood from a fresh display for chefs to prepare on the spot. Namikaze serves Japanese and Asian fusion dishes crafted to order. Taboo Beach Club rounds things off with signature cocktails and international bites in a lively beachfront setting.

hotels.vendor_name: The Fortress Resort & Spa Sri Lanka
hotels.title: Sri Lanka Beachfront Luxury with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Styled after the ramparts of historic Galle Fort and set on a private stretch of Sri Lanka's southern coast, The Fortress Resort and Spa blends Dutch colonial heritage with contemporary design. The cobbled streets, Portuguese churches and colourful bazaars of Galle's old town are only 30 minutes by car, while the stilt fishermen of Koggala cast their lines just beyond the resort's shoreline. The experience here is unhurried and deeply considered. Senses Spa fuses traditional Ayurveda and Thai healing techniques, delivering a truly distinctive approach to wellness. Beyond the spa, a sweeping infinity pool faces the Indian Ocean, three dining venues span from authentic Sri Lankan to wood-fired pizza, and the beachfront provides a quietly spectacular setting for doing very little at all.
